name: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting Covariance Transformation and Regularization
aliases: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting (3D-HGS) Covariance Transformation and Regularization
summary: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting Covariance Transformation and Regularization modifies Gaussian covariance matrices to enforce half-Gaussian shapes, eliminating ghosting artifacts by cutting ellipsoids with surface-aligned planes.
